sources.snippet: A version of g1.xml for use in MJX is available in scene_mjx.xml with the following changes: Manually designed collision geoms and corresponding contact pairs (see figure below). Tuned solver and line search iterations. Used lower, more realistic PD gains. Added home and knees_bent keyframes. The above model was successfully transfered to hardware in MuJoCo Playground.

sources.title: Humanoid-Team-ISR-Lab/G1_BrainCo_hands_Digital_Twin_Mujoco
sources.snippet: A DDS-native MuJoCo simulation of the Unitree G1 humanoid (29-DOF body) with BrainCo dexterous hands, built on top of unitree_mujoco. Control code talks to rt/lowcmd/rt/lowstate and rt/brainco/* exactly as it would on real hardware — switching from sim to robot is a two-line change (DDS domain + network interface), nothing else.

sources.title: Robot Models | unitreerobotics/unitree_mujoco | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: The unitree_mujoco system supports several Unitree Robotics robots, each with its own MJCF description files located in the unitree_robots directory. Each robot model is defined using MuJoCo's XML-based format which specifies the robot's physical properties, joints, actuators, and sensors.
